doc.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

title: Sticking with the acoustic bass
summary: He has always played acoustic bass and tries to stay out of the way.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Have you always stuck with the acoustic bass?

There’s nothing like it, it’s just what I play. I’m not in the industry, you know, I play this music. This works just fine. If it ain’t broke, don’t mess with it. Right? Because I try to get out of the way as much as possible.
